description.text: Leave central Rome for a private countryside wine tasting with hotel pickup and drop-off. Taste selected wines with local gastronomic specialties at a family-run vineyard, then return to the city after a guided cellar visit. Stops include Hotel pickup in Rome, Roman countryside vineyard. The half-day format is built for visitors who want Roman wine country without planning rural transfers on their own. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Hotel pickup in Rome, Roman countryside vineyard that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
